name: Relocation decision-support tool for comparing cities and countries

mentions.name: Relocation decision-support tool for comparing cities and countries
mentions.description: This decision-support tool helps people compare cities and countries side-by-side when considering relocation, covering safety, cost of living, quality of life, visas, and taxes. It provides structured information to reduce uncertainty around a high-stakes decision, without recommendations or pressure to move.
mentions.problem: Relocation decisions are usually fragmented and emotional, relying on blogs and anecdotes rather than structured side-by-side comparisons.
mentions.audience: People considering relocating to another city or country
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m building a decision-support tool for comparing cities and countries when considering relocation.
